title: 🎉 Qissa'25 Event Update — 17th January 2026
body: Qissa'25 will be a 1-day event on 17th January 2026. Venue: Ali Auditorium. Mark your calendars!

title: Important Update - Event Postponement
body: Due to NUML's 26th Convocation, we are now postponing our dates. Please note that 11th December 2025 is the Ambassador Orientation Day.

title: Event Dates Updated
body: The event dates have been moved to December 11-13, 2025. Please update your calendars accordingly.

title: Deadline extended
body: Submission deadline for Literature categories has been extended
